question: With which of the following has the Government of India signed a 115 million dollar Rejuvenating Watersheds for Agricultural Resilience through Innovative Development (REWARD) Program?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India has signed a **115 million dollar** agreement for the **Rejuvenating Watersheds for Agricultural Resilience through Innovative Development (REWARD) Programme** with the **World Bank**.
 
• The REWARD program aims to improve watershed management practices and enhance agricultural resilience.
 
• This initiative is part of broader efforts to ensure sustainable agricultural practices and water resource management in India.
 
• The World Bank's involvement signifies international support and collaboration in India's environmental and agricultural sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Bank** is an international** financial institution that provides loans and grants** to the governments of poorer countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• It comprises two institutions: the **International Bank for Reconstruction and Development** (IBRD), and the **International Development Association** (IDA).
 
• The World Bank's stated goal is to reduce poverty by providing loans to developing countries for development programs (e.g., bridges, roads, schools, etc.) that are expected to improve the economic prospects and quality of life for people in those countries.
 
• The REWARD program is expected to benefit a significant number of farmers and improve the efficiency of water use in agriculture.
